grammar: 本課重點是 be 動詞的 am/is/are 用法，以及 I am… 和 You are… 的句型。
intro_zh: 這一課讓學生學會用問候語和自我介紹，練習 be 動詞的 am/is/are 用法，以及 I am… 和 You are… 的句型。透過互動對話，學生能詢問對方的名字、住處和喜好，並用肢體語言表達友善。
can_do: 能用 Good morning、Good afternoon、Good evening、Good night 適時問候。
能用 I am… 和 You are… 介紹自己和他人。
能用 meet、shake hands、hug、wave、bow、clap、thumbs up 等動作表達友善。

grammar: 我們學習用 I like… 和 Do you like…? 來談論喜好，以及區分可數名詞與不可數名詞。
intro_zh: 本課繼續探索食物與三餐的話題，學生將練習說出自己喜歡或不喜歡的食物與飲料，並學會區分可數與不可數名詞，用正確的句型描述飢餓、口渴、吃飽等感受。

grammar: 本課學習 Would you like…? 與 How much…? 的句型。
intro_zh: 在這一課，我們將學會用禮貌的方式詢問朋友想喝什麼飲料或想吃什麼水果與小吃，並練習詢問價格與數量。透過圖片與對話練習，讓學生能在日常生活中自然使用 Would you like…? 與 How much…? 。
can_do: 能用 Would you like…? 詢問對方想喝的飲料。
能用 How much…? 詢問水果或小吃的價格。

sentences.en: We also see a basket with grapes, guava, papaya, peach, kiwi, mango and pineapple.

grammar: 學習使用祈使句（如 Open your book!）和 Let's… 提出建議。
intro_zh: 這一課將透過課堂上的小實驗，學習如何用祈使句給予指令，以及用 Let's… 提出一起做某事的建議，同時練習本課的重要單字。學生會在故事中看到老師和同學如何互相說明步驟，並體會使用正確的語氣讓課堂更有秩序。

sentences.en: Let's begin a simple experiment about growing beans.
sentences.zh: 讓我們開始一個簡單的種豆實驗。

sentences.en: Ms. Lin reminds us to keep the room safe and avoid anything dangerous.
sentences.zh: 林老師提醒我們要保持教室安全，避免做任何危險的事。

sentences.en: First, we get a cup, fill it with soil, and place a bean inside.
sentences.zh: 首先，我們拿到一個杯子，裡面裝滿土，然後放入一顆豆子。

sentences.en: We water it gently and then put the cup on the windowsill.
sentences.zh: 我們輕輕澆水，然後把杯子放在窗台上。

sentences.en: After a few days, a small sprout will appear, begin to grow, and then become a young plant.
sentences.zh: 幾天後，小芽會出現，開始生長，然後變成小植物。

sentences.en: We must stay quiet and let the plant get enough light, otherwise it will be difficult to grow.
sentences.zh: 我們必須保持安靜，讓植物得到足夠的光線，否則它會很難生長。

sentences.en: If the soil feels hard, we loosen it so the roots can spread easily.
sentences.zh: 如果土壤感覺很硬，我們會鬆開它，讓根部可以輕鬆伸展。

sentences.en: We learn that plants need basic things: water, sunlight, and air.
sentences.zh: 我們學到植物需要基本的東西：水、陽光和空氣。

sentences.en: Sometimes something unexpected happens, like a leaf turning yellow, and we want to find out why.
sentences.zh: 有時會發生意外的事，例如葉子變黃，我們想要知道原因。

sentences.en: At the end, we compare our plants and see if they are the same or different, and we feel special because we made them grow.
sentences.zh: 最後，我們比較我們的植物，看它們是否相同或不同，並且因為我們讓它們長大而感到特別。

能聽懂並回應別人對感覺的描述
能閱讀短文並回答關於情緒的問題

sentences.en: This morning Xiao Ming felt excited because he was going to the school science fair.
sentences.zh: 今天早上小明感到興奮，因為他要去參加學校科學展。

sentences.en: When he arrived, he noticed the crowd was loud and he felt a little afraid, but he was also surprised to see his friends, and he felt angry when someone bumped into him.
sentences.zh: 他到達時，注意到人群很吵，他感到有點害怕，但看到朋友也感到驚訝，當有人撞到他時他感到生氣。

sentences.en: During the fair, he felt proud when his project won a prize, and he felt happy about his hard work.
sentences.zh: 在展覽期間，他的項目獲獎時他感到驕傲，並且對自己的努力感到快樂。

sentences.en: After the fair, Xiao Ming felt tired and a bit weak because he had walked all day.
sentences.zh: 展覽結束後，小明感到疲倦且有點虛弱，因為他整天走路。

sentences.en: He felt bored on the bus ride home, and he wished he could do something more fun.
sentences.zh: 回家的公車上他感到無聊，願意做更有趣的事。

sentences.en: When he got home, he noticed his little sister was sick and looked unhappy.
sentences.zh: 回到家時，他注意到妹妹生病了，看起來不高興。

sentences.en: He felt sad and lonely because he could not play with her, but he stayed to keep her company.
sentences.zh: 他感到悲傷且孤單，因為不能和她玩，但他留下來陪她。

sentences.en: Later, his mom gave him a free snack and said he was lucky to have such a caring family.
sentences.zh: 媽媽給他一份免費的點心，並說他很幸運擁有這樣關心的家庭。

sentences.en: Finally, Xiao Ming felt comfortable and glad as he rested, knowing tomorrow would be another great day.
sentences.zh: 最後，小明感到舒適且高興，因為他知道明天又會是美好的一天。

title_zh: 心情與原因——我的感受與想法
grammar: 用 How do you feel? 和 I feel... because... 來表達心情和原因
intro_zh: 每個人每天都有不同的心情。有時候開心，有時候難過，有時候擔心。你知道嗎？我們的心情都有原因的。這一課裡，我們要學會用英文表達自己的感受，也要學會解釋為什麼會有這些感受。一起來認識更多關於心情的英文單字吧！
can_do: 能用英文說出自己現在的心情
能用『because』解釋心情的原因
能聽懂別人問『你感覺如何』並做出回應

sentences.en: I tried hard to study, and I hoped I could do well.
sentences.zh: 我努力讀書，希望能考得好。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, I got my test back and felt joy because I got 95 points!

sentences.en: But then my friend got hurt, and I felt sad because he had to cry a little.
sentences.zh: 但是我的朋友受傷了，他哭了，我感到難過。

sentences.en: I decided to help him feel better, so we sat down and talked.
sentences.zh: 我決定幫他感覺更好，所以我們坐下來聊天。

sentences.en: He smiled and said he believed I was a good friend.
sentences.zh: 他笑了，說他相信我是個好朋友。

sentences.en: On Saturday, I enjoyed playing games with my whole family.
sentences.zh: 星期六，我欣賞和全家人一起玩遊戲。

sentences.en: My little sister gave me a kiss and said she wished every day could be like this.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹親吻我，說她希望每一天都能這樣。

sentences.en: I agree with her—happy moments with family mean the most to me!
sentences.zh: 我同意她——和家人在一起的快樂時光對我來說最重要！

intro_zh: 在這堂課裡，我們會學習用英文說出自己的感受，並說明為什麼會有這種心情。透過生活情境，練習問答和描述，讓英語表達更自然吧。

sentences.en: Today is Saturday, and Lily feels nervous because she has a baseball game.
sentences.zh: 今天是星期六，莉莉感到緊張，因為她有一場棒球比賽。

sentences.en: She warms up with her team, and they cheer each other.
sentences.zh: 她和隊友一起熱身，互相加油。

sentences.en: Lily is a polite player, and she always listens to her coach.
sentences.zh: 莉莉是個有禮貌的運動員，她總是聽從教練的指示。

sentences.en: During the game, she feels shy when the crowd laughs at her funny mistake.
sentences.zh: 比賽進行時，當觀眾笑她的有趣錯誤時，莉莉感到害羞。

sentences.en: But her friend Tom says, “Don’t worry, it’s just fun!” and gives her a ball.
sentences.zh: 但她的朋友湯姆說：「別擔心，這只是很有趣！」並給她一個球。

sentences.en: After the game, they go to the park to play basketball and tennis for exercise.
sentences.zh: 比賽結束後，他們去公園打籃球和網球來運動。

sentences.en: Lily thinks sport is her hobby, and she makes it a habit to practice every week.
sentences.zh: 莉莉認為運動是她的嗜好，她養成每週練習的習慣。

sentences.en: Sometimes she feels bored when it rains, but she reads a quiet book to stay calm.
sentences.zh: 有時候下雨時她會感到無聊，但她會讀一本安靜的書來保持平靜。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, Lily feels happy because she was careful and did her best.
sentences.zh: 一天結束時，莉莉感到開心，因為她很小心，並且盡力而為。

sentences.en: When Lily forgot her baseball glove, she was in trouble, but her teammate lent her one.
sentences.zh: 當莉莉忘記帶棒球手套時，她陷入麻煩，但隊友借給她一個。

grammar: 本課重點是使用第三人稱單數的 present simple 來問答職業，以及學習 want to be… 的結構。
intro_zh: 這一課教我們用「What does he/she do?」問答不同職業，並練習「want to be...」表達未來願望。認識士兵、郵差、推銷員等，了解各種工作的特色與態度。

sentences.zh: 他做什麼工作？他是守護鎮上的士兵，而且任何人只要有勇氣都有可能加入軍隊。

sentences.zh: 她是郵差，每天早上都送信，即使天氣下雨也不例外。

sentences.en: The salesman at the store is friendly, popular, and always honest with his customers.
sentences.zh: 商店裡的推銷員很友善、受歡迎，而且對顧客總是誠實的。

sentences.en: He is smart and able to fix broken bikes quickly, but he never calls anyone stupid.
sentences.zh: 他很聰明，能夠快速修好壞掉的腳踏車，但他從不叫別人笨。

sentences.en: Although she is poor, she is hard‑working and dreams of being successful one day.
sentences.zh: 雖然她很貧窮，但她很勤勉，夢想有一天能夠成功。

sentences.en: The rich businessman is busy, yet he finds time to help the poor and is known for being wise.
sentences.zh: 那位有錢的商人很忙，但他仍會抽出時間幫助貧窮的人，並以智慧著稱。

sentences.en: Some people think his ideas are strange, but he is crazy about inventions and wants to be famous.
sentences.zh: 有些人覺得他的想法很奇怪，但他對發明很著迷，並且想要出名。

sentences.en: The lazy student never does homework, yet he hopes to be a popular video‑game streamer someday.

sentences.en: In the end, everyone agrees that being kind, serious, and honest makes a person truly admirable.
sentences.zh: 最後，大家都同意善良、認真和誠實才能讓一個人真正令人敬佩。

grammar_points.title_zh: ① 第三人稱單數現在簡單式 - 問職業與描述

grammar: 學習用 How do you go…? by bus 詢問交通方式，並初探過去式動詞。
intro_zh: 本課透過 Lily 的旅行故事，介紹各國節慶如中國新年、端午節、中秋節、萬聖節、聖誕節等，練習詢問交通方式並初探過去式動詞，讓學生能描述自己去過的地方和參與的活動。
can_do: 能用 How do you go…? by bus 詢問朋友的交通方式。
能用過去式說明自己去過的國家和參與的節慶。
能說出至少五個國家的名稱和對應的節慶。

sentences.en: Lily loves to travel and learn about festivals around the world.
sentences.zh: 莉莉喜歡旅行，並學習世界各地的節慶。

sentences.en: Last year she went to Malaysia to celebrate Chinese New Year and got a red envelope.
sentences.zh: 去年她去馬來西亞慶祝中國新年，並收到了紅包。

sentences.en: In Malaysia she watched a Dragon Boat Festival race and ate sweet rice dumplings.
sentences.zh: 在馬來西亞，她觀看了端午節賽艇，並吃了甜甜的糯米糰。

sentences.en: Then she flew to Canada to see the colourful autumn leaves and celebrate Halloween.
sentences.zh: 之後她飛往加拿大，欣賞彩色的秋葉，並慶祝萬聖節。

sentences.en: She carved a pumpkin and wore a funny costume.
sentences.zh: 她雕刻南瓜，並穿上有趣的服裝。

sentences.en: After Canada, Lily visited England and joined a Christmas market.
sentences.zh: 離開加拿大後，莉莉去英國參加了聖誕市場。

sentences.en: She met Santa Claus and received a present wrapped in shiny paper.
sentences.zh: 她遇見了聖誕老人，收到了用閃亮紙包裝的禮物。

sentences.en: Next, she traveled to France and enjoyed the Moon Festival with moon cake.
sentences.zh: 接著她前往法國，享用中秋節的月餅。

sentences.en: In Australia she saw the Great Barrier Reef and bought a small gift for her brother.
sentences.zh: 在澳洲，她看到了大堡礁，並為弟弟買了一份小禮物。

sentences.en: In India she joined a Diwali celebration, and in Germany she enjoyed Oktoberfest, practicing past simple to say 'I went by bus' and 'I saw many festivals'.
sentences.zh: 在印度，她參與了迪瓦利節慶；在德國，她享受了啤酒節，並練習過去式說：我搭巴士去的，我看到了許多節慶。

grammar_points.title_zh: ① How do you go…? by bus
grammar_points.explain_zh: 用來詢問前往某地的交通方式，答案通常用 by + 交通工具。
table: How do you go to Malaysia?
I go to Malaysia by bus.
How do you go to Canada?
She goes to Canada by bus.
How do you go to Australia?
We go to Australia by bus.

grammar_points.title_zh: ② 過去式初探（規則動詞）
grammar_points.explain_zh: 規則動詞在過去式加 -ed，表示已經發生的事。
